notes.title: Demo News
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Not sure if anyone reads these, but none the less...

There's a demo and there are a few things you need to know.

I'll be updating the demo soon with game pad support. I just need to do 2 things first:

[list]
[*] I need to update the key binding to support game pad features. 
[*] Finalize a few more button sequence special attacks
[/list]

That's right, there are special moves Shinryu can perform. 2 of them are already in the game. 
I'm trying to figure out how to approach this. I kind of like the idea having people "figure it out".
Which, I think, older generations will appreciate. 

I also may settle on a middle ground with a move list that you can reveal by doing the move.   
I do want all moves available from the beginning.

There also is Early Access, but I'm only making it available to itch right now. Mostly because Steam will get a version that supports Steam features, and it's easier to avoid/manage brain rotten gamers during the EA process.  

Once I get the main systems into the demo, I'll be building the game out more. I think I'm at the 95% completion point for that.
